name: Admin incoming stock updates inventory and ledger
description: Verify transactional stock-in, dashboard totals, product stock, ledger filtering, and CSV export.

planSteps.description: Log in as admin, open Tambah stok masuk, select Minimal Desk Lamp, enter quantity 3, reason Restock TestSprite, reference TS-STOCK-20260716, and submit.
Verify success shows the correct before and after stock values and the saved product stock increases by exactly 3.
Open Riwayat Stok and search for TS-STOCK-20260716.
Verify exactly the incoming movement is shown with Minimal Desk Lamp, +3, stock before/after, reason, and reference.
Use the type and product filters, then click Ekspor.
Verify filters preserve the matching ledger row and a riwayat-stok.csv download is triggered.
